title: PaperBuildV1
description: Owner-scoped immutable paper builds. Tasks own execution state; only successful receipts may replace a successful PDF. Unverified remote versions are preview-only. PDF and location queries name the same build_id.

build.name: paper_build_bundle
build.description: Compile an Overleaf project once and lease its immutable PDF, SyncTeX and log artifacts. Source revision is unverified. This consumes remote compile capacity.

read.name: paper_read_artifact
read.description: Read one bounded chunk from a leased immutable paper build. Does not compile.

release.name: paper_release_build
release.description: Release an owned paper artifact lease and its temporary files.
